[spoiler=Natural Expansion]It was the start of the new year, the recently established empire of Gendarme had just selected its lineage that would take the crown of the nation. And a parliament was in the works of creation, Gendarme struggled with multiple problems though. She was fighting an ongoing energy crisis, as a large cold from Rossiya hit the country and sent shockwaves across the nation. Gendarme lacked adequate natural resources that it needed to produce the energy it needed. And so she needed to look outwards, Erene was a large uncharted globe that had lots of land open to conquer. One land that took interest of the Gendarmites was the large island that layed next to the country. Normandy, also known as Normandie was a former territory of the Gendarmite Empire. It only seceded from the country in 1986 after a group of hardliners conspired to overthrow the crumbling leadership. Causing panic among the Gendarmite commonwealth. Which lead to Normandie holding a referendum to secede from the union, the vote won 78 to 22. And as Gendarme was in crumbling turmoil, the former great empire could do nothing but watch as Normandie seceded. But now, Gendarme would be able to reabsorb the seceding territory rightful back into Gendarme. Multiple steps would be taken to make sure that an annexation was successful, Gendarme would begin to buy out Normandiean markets and begin offering national aid to businesses that transferred their ownership to Gendarme. This would prove successful as Gendarme would begin to get an Irongrip on the Normandiean economy. And with the Normandieans mainly speaking Grinch as their main language, the integration into Gendarme would be faster.

Expansion of the Gendarmite Overseas territories

In the seas of southern Vespuria, layed a strategic island chain that would be beneficial for the Gendarmites if conquered. These islands were uncontrolled and left vulnerable by the Gendarmite army. And so on January 23rd, 2025, during midnight. The Gendarmite Naval 23rd Battallion would reach the shores of the island chain to conquer it. By dawn of the 24th, the Gendarmite flag would be raised upon every single island within the chain and the army would see little resistence within the new formed colony. The Gendarmite overseas territory would be expanded and the territory would directly join as a legitimate part of Gendarme.

Acquisition of the South Amarallo Territory

One more territory would lay in interest within the Gendarmite Kingdom, the island chain of Southern Amarallo near New Aerenenge was home to lots of resources that Gendarme could use to power its raging power crisis. And so Gendarmite ambassadors would be dispatched to the region to propose the buying of territory from the uncharted emperors. Negotiations between multiple kingdoms and the Gendarmerie would begin and Gendarme would make a proposal for the emperors to forfeit their sovereignty for a combined 10B$ and protection from New Aerenenge by the Gendarmite government. And on January 24th, 2025. All territories would join the Gendarmite commonwealth.
[/spoiler]
